Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah met Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Hyderabad House in New Delhi for bilateral talks, focusing on strengthening India-Nepal relations and discussing key regional and global issues.
However, ahead of the visit, former Nepal Foreign Minister Pradeep Kumar Gyawali flagged a growing trust deficit between Kathmandu and New Delhi. He urged Balen Shah to use the visit to rebuild mutual confidence and address long-pending concerns, including border disputes, the 1950 India-Nepal Treaty and trade agreements.
